query:
SELECT s.snapshot_date AS "snapshot_date!",
                  s.stars AS "stars!",
                  s.forks AS "forks!",
                  s.watchers,
                  s.stars_today
           FROM snapshots s
           JOIN repos r ON r.id = s.repo_id
           WHERE r.full_name = $1
             AND s.board = $2
             AND s.snapshot_date >= $3
             AND s.snapshot_date <= $4
           ORDER BY s.snapshot_date ASC
